item.title: EU due to publish its third CBAM certificate price, after €75.36 and €75.28 in the first half
item.description: The European Commission was due to publish the CBAM certificate price for Q3 2026 on 5 October. Q1 2026 was €75.36 per tonne of CO2 (published 7 April) and Q2 €75.28 (6 July), calculated from EU ETS auction prices. CBAM has applied in its definitive regime since 1 January 2026; importers above a 50-tonne threshold must be authorised declarants, and the first declaration falls due on 30 September 2027.
item.source: European Commission — Price of CBAM certificates

item.title: Drewry index slips 1% to $4,468 per 40ft as carriers pull sailings before Golden Week
item.description: Drewry's World Container Index fell 1% to USD 4,468 per 40ft container on 24 September 2026. Shanghai–Los Angeles rose 2% to $7,838 and Shanghai–New York held at $10,373, while Shanghai–Genoa fell 5% to $3,835 and Shanghai–Rotterdam 4% to $3,485. Carriers have announced 15 blank sailings on the transpacific for next week, up from nine.
item.source: Drewry — World Container Index, assessed 24 September 2026

item.title: worldsteel: August crude steel output down 1.2% as the gains shift to Africa and North America
item.description: worldsteel reports 144.2 Mt of crude steel in August 2026, down 1.2% year on year, and 1,225.2 Mt for January–August, down 0.7%. Africa rose 8.8% and North America 3.9%; Asia and Oceania, about 74% of the month's total, fell 1.4%. Viet Nam was the fastest-growing top-ten producer at +36.4%.
item.source: World Steel Association (worldsteel) — August 2026 crude steel production

item.title: US issues final rebar duties of up to 136.57% on Bulgaria, Egypt and Vietnam
item.description: Commerce published final antidumping and countervailing duty orders on steel concrete reinforcing bar from Bulgaria, Egypt and Vietnam on 18 September 2026. Dumping margins run from 34.20% for Egypt's Ezz Group to 136.57% for Vietnam's all-others rate, with subsidy rates of 23.27% for Egypt and 6.80% for Vietnam.
item.source: Federal Register — Steel Concrete Reinforcing Bar From Bulgaria, Egypt, and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Antidumping Duty Orders (18 September 2026)

item.title: Global crude steel output steady at 149.2 Mt as regions pull apart
item.description: worldsteel: the 70 reporting countries produced 149.2 Mt of crude steel in July 2026, down 0.3% year on year. North America rose 4.9% and the EU 3.8%, the Middle East fell 13.4%, and Asia and Oceania — about 73% of the total — slipped 1.2%.
item.source: World Steel Association (worldsteel) — July 2026 crude steel production

item.title: Container rates hold at $4,476 per 40ft for a second week
item.description: Drewry's World Container Index stayed at $4,476 per 40ft container. Shanghai–Los Angeles rose 2% to $7,352 and Shanghai–New York 1% to $9,726, while Shanghai–Genoa fell 3% to $4,216 and Shanghai–Rotterdam 2% to $3,997.

item.title: Eurostat: EU industrial output up 0.3% year on year as capital goods lead
item.description: Eurostat's first estimate for July 2026 puts euro area industrial production down 0.1% from June and EU output down 0.3%. Year on year the euro area was flat and the EU up 0.3%, with capital goods output up 2.4% in the EU against a 3.2% fall in non-durable consumer goods.
item.source: Eurostat — Industrial production down by 0.1% in the euro area and by 0.3% in the EU (16 September 2026)

item.title: World Bank: energy index up 8.8% in August, European gas at USD 21.11/mmBtu
item.description: The World Bank's September Pink Sheet puts its energy price index up 8.8% in August, led by natural gas (+10.1%) and crude oil (+5.7%). European gas averaged USD 21.11/mmBtu against USD 2.77 in the United States; the metals index rose 4.0% while iron ore eased to USD 96.3/dmt.
item.source: World Bank — Commodity Markets: Pink Sheet, September 2026

item.title: 30,000 t/yr precision casting expansion clears environmental approval
item.description: The Botou plant's precision casting expansion received environmental approval on 24 December 2025 (approval no. 泊审环表〔2025〕55号), covering an investment of RMB 5.1 million. Phase one has already entered completed-project environmental acceptance.

item.title: Paint line rebuilt as a sealed, negative-pressure coating workshop
item.description: The coating process upgrade was filed in June 2024 (filing no. 泊发改审批备字〔2024〕127号) and built inside a new workshop of about 1,500 m², with sealed sanding and spray booths under indoor negative pressure.

item.title: Recognised as a Hebei Specialised, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative SME
item.description: The provincial rating recognises companies with a focused product line, proprietary technology and steady growth. This certificate is valid until 28 March 2027.

item.title: Certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise
item.description: The national high-tech enterprise designation is granted to companies that meet R&D spending, technology-transfer and intellectual-property thresholds in their field.
